default: Existing two-argument Session and ordinary Tunnel constructors retain TCP socket delivery; N64 and RetroArch do not use the native endpoint

factory.admission: Existing exact signed roster mask, linkId, hostSide and ownerSlot checks precede endpoint construction

dpl1.transport: Concatenated frames over each authenticated TSR3 byte stream; arbitrary outer DATA fragmentation is allowed

native.reader: nativeTakeOutgoing(remoteSlot, 100), null/empty means bounded idle wait
native.retry: 0 retries the identical ID and bytes after a bounded wait; -1 rejects; 1 only queues native bytes
native.acknowledgment: nativeAwaitDelivery(deliveryId, 100) must return true before rx.confirm(frameEndOffset)
native.identityLifetime: Positive AtomicLong allocator shared by all channels and sessions in this process; exhaustion fails without wrap or reuse
native.close: Per-channel endpoint does not close the shared native transport; its owning Activity/session performs the explicit native close

barrier.pausedPreparation: Preparation DATA remains independent of RUN and may carry official ENet connection packets while the signed global pause is active
barrier.outgoingReadGuard: endpointReading excludes READY while native bytes are being removed from a native queue or held waiting for TSR3 credit
barrier.nativeReady: Existing real nativeStatus pause/drained epoch requirements remain unchanged
barrier.incomingReady: An incomplete frame or unconsumed native datagram remains unconfirmed in rx and prevents READY
barrier.timeouts: Bounded idle, delivery and acknowledgment waits never disconnect or close the native session

memory.retention: Unconfirmed fragmented input remains in the bounded TSR3 receive ring; outgoing bytes remain in its retransmission ring until authenticated ACCEPTED confirms them
